# Security policy

## Supported versions

Computase currently supports the latest published 0.1.x release. Security fixes
will be released from the latest supported version rather than backported to
earlier 0.1.x releases.

## Report a vulnerability privately

Do not report suspected vulnerabilities in a public issue.

Use
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/madhusudan-kulkarni/computase/security/advisories/new)
to share the affected version, reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested
mitigation. Please minimize any example sequence and remove patient-derived,
proprietary, embargoed, unpublished, or otherwise sensitive data.

We aim to acknowledge a report within seven days and will provide status updates
as the report is assessed and addressed. Please allow time for a fix and release
before public disclosure.
